Class CockroachHarness

java.lang.Object
com.cockroachlabs.crdb.testing.CockroachHarness
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class CockroachHarness extends Object implements AutoCloseable
A CockroachDB test harness with two backends:
  • container — spins up an ephemeral single-node CockroachDB via Testcontainers (container()). Requires Docker at test runtime only; this class compiles and links without a running Docker daemon.
  • external — targets an already-running node by JDBC URL (external(String)), e.g. a local dev cluster or a CI service.

AutoCloseable so it can be used in try-with-resources; closing a container-backed harness stops the container, while closing an external one is a no-op.
